text_block_list.text:
During training, Smart Falcon spoke to me 
while catching her breath...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... What should I do... 
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's body just won't shake off this 
fatigue... I can't do my cutie training 
like this!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... In order to become a top Umadol, 
I have to build up some peppy, cute 
muscles!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And yet... when I'm this tired, all I can 
manage is pathetic training...!

"...She seems to have accumulated quite a 
bit of fatigue. It might be best to 
reconsider her race schedule."
